chunks: Al-Shaykh informed me, from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

When you bring the deceased to the grave, lower him in from the direction of his feet. Then when you place him in the grave, recite Āyat al-Kursī and say: In the Name of Allah, and by Allah, and in the way of Allah, and upon the creed of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله. O Allah, bless Muḥammad and his family. O Allah, make his grave spacious for him, and join him to his Prophet Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله. And say, as you said in the salat over him, once, beginning from: O Allah, if he was virtuous, then increase his virtue; and if he was sinful, then forgive him, have mercy on him, and pardon him. And seek forgiveness for him as much as you are able.
He said: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام, when he entered the grave, would say: O Allah, draw the earth away from his sides, raise up his deed, and cause him to meet with Your good pleasure.

key_terms.آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ: the Qur'anic verse recommended to be recited at burial
key_terms.افْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ: make his grave spacious and ease his condition therein
key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave into which the deceased is placed
key_terms.مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the religious way or creed of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: What should be recited and said when placing a deceased person into the grave in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the recommended acts and supplications to be performed when placing the deceased into the grave. It combines burial etiquette, recitation, salat upon Muḥammad and his family, and du'a for forgiveness, mercy, and ease for the deceased in the grave.
